input: Review and update my life insurance beneficiaries

gold.taskTitle: Review and Update Life Insurance Beneficiaries
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to review their current life insurance policy beneficiaries and make any necessary updates to ensure the designations are accurate and current.

questions.title: How many life insurance policies do you currently have?
questions.description: Understand the number of policies that need to be reviewed and updated.

questions.title: Who are the policies held through, employer or private insurer?
questions.description: Identify whether the policies are employer-sponsored, privately held, or both, as the update process differs.

questions.title: What life event is prompting this review right now?
questions.description: Understand the trigger for the update, such as marriage, divorce, birth of a child, or death of a previously named beneficiary.

questions.title: Do you already know who the new beneficiaries should be?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has decided on the new beneficiary designations or needs help thinking through the options.

questions.title: Do you need to assign both primary and contingent beneficiaries?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user needs to designate only primary beneficiaries or also contingent ones as backups.

questions.title: Do you have login or physical access to your policy documents?
questions.description: Assess whether the user can readily access their policy information online, through an agent, or only via paper documents.

questions.title: Is there a specific deadline by which this must be completed?
questions.description: Identify any time pressure, such as an open enrollment window, legal deadline, or personal urgency.
